polish.details: Standalone screenshot confirms full UI renders (not blank). Preset-tour copy is fully updated to active language ('click one — each isolates a single idea'; caption 'click a lesson preset to load it, then tweak a knob') with no remaining 'arrives next stage'/'coming soon' text. Buttons have hover (.tour-btn:hover) and armed (.tour-btn.armed) feedback states; lesson tooltips (TIPS lessonStraight..lessonQuantize) are thorough and pedagogically coherent. Only blemish: the CSS class name '.tour-soon' (styles.css:446) is a leftover from the old 'coming soon' state — purely a stale identifier, the rendered text and muted-italic styling are correct.

consistency.details: Native-fn sets are identical both sides — C++ withNativeFunction {setStep, getGrid, clearGrid, applyPreset, getSampleRate} (PluginEditor.cpp:101-131) exactly equals JS getNativeFunction lookups (app.js:574-578); no orphan name on either side. The six .tour-btn data-preset labels (index.html:110-115) match BeatPresets.h kBeatPresets[].name byte-for-byte AND in the same DOM/array index order (0 Straight, 1 Backbeat + Accents, 2 Ghost Notes, 3 Triplet Swing, 4 Humanized, 5 Quantize Demo), so the forEach index passed to applyPresetFn(index) maps to the correct preset. TIPS lesson titles also match the labels. Voice roster order (VOICES) stays in lock-step with kVoicePrefix/kGmNotes; velocity tiers (40/100/127) consistent JS↔BeatPresets.

thread_safety.details: Member declaration order is correct: relays (sliderRelays/comboRelays/toggleRelays, PluginEditor.h:50-52) → webView (line 55) → attachments (lines 58-60), so reverse-destruction is safe. stopTimer() present in destructor (PluginEditor.cpp:184); timerCallback() null-checks webView first (line 190). All 42 relays (29 slider + 1 combo + 12 toggle) registered via withOptionsFrom loops (lines 94-96); attachments null-guarded with jassert. Stage 4 added no relays/attachments — the 42-param contract is frozen; applyPreset native fn runs on the message thread and delegates to processorRef.applyConceptPreset (setValueNotifyingHost for feel params, existing atomic grid writers), no audio-thread access added.

accessibility.details: Optional. Knobs expose role=slider with aria-valuemin/max/now/valuetext and aria-label, tabindex, plus arrow-key and wheel control (app.js:138-172). Grid cells expose role=button, aria-pressed and a descriptive aria-label, with Enter/Space cycle and Delete/Backspace clear (app.js:275-284). Tooltips fire on focusin/focusout so keyboard users get the same teaching copy; Escape dismisses. Preset buttons are native <button> elements (keyboard-activable by default).

issues.description: The preset-tour subtitle uses the CSS class '.tour-soon' (defined styles.css:446), a stale name carried over from the pre-Stage-4 'coming soon' state. The visible copy is fully updated and the styling renders correctly, so this is a non-visible naming artifact only — no user-facing impact.
issues.fixSuggestion: Rename the '.tour-soon' class to a state-neutral name such as '.tour-hint' in both index.html and styles.css to remove the stale 'coming soon' connotation; cosmetic cleanup, safe to defer.
